annotations.title: Check eligibility for a US grant

description: Use this when the user asks whether they qualify for a specific US funding program (by name or from earlier results), or shares business details after a search. Checks base requirements — state, organization type, ownership, size, industry — and returns meets / does not meet / need to know for each, an overall likely-fit verdict, and what else to check. Works with partial details: it returns what is already known and lists exactly which questions to ask next. A likely fit is not a guarantee. Not for scholarships, personal loans, or non-US programs.

employees.description: Number of employees (0 for a solo founder).

founder_groups.description: Owner identity groups — ONLY if the user volunteered this. Some programs are reserved for these groups. Never ask for it unprompted; use "none" if the user said none apply.

industry.description: Closest industry. A bakery or restaurant is food_beverage; a shop is retail_consumer. Omit if unclear.

org_type.description: How the organization is registered. Omit if the user hasn't said.

program_name.description: The program's name, if no slug is known (e.g. "Amber Grant").

slug.description: The program's slug from search_grants results (preferred).

state.description: US state where the business operates — 2-letter code (e.g. "OH") or full name.

years_operating.description: Years the business has been operating (0 if not launched yet).

name: check_eligibility
title: Check eligibility for a US grant
